events.title: Seated Stick Fighting
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Sit down, fight back! Join Strange Fox Fighting Arts for an intro to wielding a stick, shillelagh, or yer everyday cane while off your feet. You’ll play with basic offensive and defensive concepts from a seated adaptation of bataireacht (Irish stick fighting), designed by a spoony for spoonies! And, you’ll get the chance to play-fight/spar 😈! Class prioritizes those who can’t stand at all or for long. Trans folks to the front/open to all. Roll in yer chair or pull up a seat in the bookstore and join us! Space is limited! Sticks provided (tho yer welcome to bring yer own cane, too). Masks required!
